name: Currency To Buy Or Sell 1 Choice

CurrencyToBuy.name: Currency To Buy
CurrencyToBuy.definition: Account servicer is instructed to buy the indicated currency after the receipt of cash proceeds.

CurrencyToSell.name: Currency To Sell
CurrencyToSell.definition: Account servicer is instructed to sell the indicated currency in order to obtain the necessary currency to fund the transaction.
